heading: Kehilangan barang saat berbelanja?
text: Silakan hubungi tim Customer Service kami atau datangi Concierge Desk di Lantai Dasar untuk bantuan. Barang yang ditemukan disimpan selama 3 bulan sebelum dimusnahkan. Bukti kepemilikan diperlukan saat pengambilan.
text_en: Please contact our Customer Service Team or visit the Concierge Desk on the Ground Floor for assistance. Found items are kept for 3 months before disposal. Proof of ownership is required when claiming.
